recency_elevated.description: Recency is materially above normal interval

spend_declining.description: Recent 90-day spend is materially below historical baseline

frequency_declining.description: Recent 90-day purchase frequency is below historical cadence

return_risk.description: Elevated return behavior relative to purchases

rules.rationale: High return rate detected. Focus on reducing margin bleed before issuing generic discounts.
Customer has proven historical affinity but is showing severe signs of churn.
Customer is highly active and likely to return, but spend is dropping. Intervene to retain share of wallet.
Customer is highly engaged and likely to buy again. Focus on discovery rather than deep discounting.
Customer is establishing a habit. Nurture into next purchase to solidify loyalty.
Lowest-value and lowest-likelihood population. Do not spend expensive targeting budget here.
Fallback recommendation for customers not matching specific high-priority rules.

HIGH.description: Strong alignment with sufficient baseline history.

LOW.description: Limited history, fallback policy, or conflicting signals.
